analysis: R3 — partial correlation of Phi and S controlling for connectivity (and system size)
verdict: The raw Phi-S correlation (+0.65) is a CONNECTIVITY CONFOUND. Controlling for connectivity (sum|W|) collapses it to -0.02 (perm p=0.77); adding system size n leaves it at +0.09 (p=0.17), indistinguishable from zero. No residual Phi-S association survives the control. Combined with the earlier finding that Phi<=S is falsified for every nonzero-Phi system, section 8 retains no defensible claim: the bound is false AND the apparent correlation is an artifact of both quantities rising with network connectivity.
